en: Good morning, guys. We have a fun day ahead of us.
zh: 早上好，大家。今天有很有趣的行程等着我们。

en: I mean, we don't really have it planned out thoroughly, but we know
zh: 我是说，其实我们也没有把行程规划得特别详细，不过我们知道，

en: that we want to go to this beach called Boulders Beach.
zh: 我们想去一个叫博尔德斯海滩的地方。

en: What's unique about it is that penguins live there.
zh: 它特别的地方在于，那里住着企鹅。

en: Helgi was reading for me from the internet that apparently it was two penguins that arrived there in 90...
zh: Helgi 刚刚在网上给我读到，说好像是有两只企鹅在 90……那时候来到那里的。

en: When was it? 1986. 1986.
zh: 是哪一年来着？1986 年。1986 年。

en: They basically created the penguin community there.
zh: 基本上可以说，是它们在那里建立起了那个企鹅群落。

en: And this is one of the only places on Earth where you can go to a beach
zh: 而且这里也是地球上少数几个你可以去海滩

en: and meet penguins. I think they just really enjoyed the beachy lifestyle.
zh: 还能见到企鹅的地方之一。我觉得它们应该就是特别喜欢这种海边生活方式。

en: It's honestly so cute and I'm really excited.
zh: 说真的，太可爱了，我真的特别期待。

en: So we wanted to go for a little drive and I haven't really told you guys
zh: 所以我们想开车出去转一转，而且我其实还没有真正跟你们说过

en: where we're currently staying. So we're actually staying in a small village called Scarborough.
zh: 我们现在住在哪里。其实我们住在一个叫 Scarborough 的小村子里。

en: Yeah, it's a little bit outside of Cape Town and I'm honestly so happy
zh: 对，它离开普敦稍微有一点距离，说实话，我真的特别开心

en: that we decided to stay here.
zh: 我们决定住在这里。

en: We actually just found this Airbnb and we thought it was just so beautiful
zh: 其实我们就是找到这家 Airbnb，当时就觉得它真的太漂亮了，

en: and the reviews were just so amazing and we thought it would be so fun to stay outside of Cape Town for a little getaway,
zh: 而且评价也特别好，我们就觉得住在开普敦外面一点的地方，来一次短途度假，会特别有意思，

en: a little bit more quiet.
zh: 也会更安静一些。

en: It is just absolutely amazing here and I'm kind of sad that we're gonna be leaving in a couple of days
zh: 这里真的美得不可思议，我都有点舍不得，因为再过几天我们就要离开这里了，

en: and we're gonna be staying in Cape Town but I'm also really,
zh: 然后我们会住到开普敦市区去，不过我也真的，

en: really, really excited to explore Cape Town for the very first time.
zh: 真的、真的非常期待第一次好好探索开普敦。

en: But yeah, we wanted to grab some breakfast before heading to this beach
zh: 不过呢，我们想先去吃个早餐，然后再去那个海滩，

en: and the first day we arrived in South Africa, we didn't get the Airbnb until like two o 'clock
zh: 而且我们到南非的第一天，差不多到下午两点才入住 Airbnb，

en: and we arrived six in the morning so we had a few hours to spare
zh: 但我们早上六点就到了，所以中间还有几个小时可以打发，

en: and we actually found this little cafe van and it's located at a small beach
zh: 然后我们就真的发现了一辆很可爱的小咖啡餐车，它就在一个小海滩那边，

en: and we just went there and we ordered coffee and grilled sandwiches
zh: 我们就去了那里，点了咖啡和烤三明治，

en: and it was such a good vibe.
zh: 整个氛围特别好。

en: There were so many people there and so many dogs.
zh: 那里人很多，狗狗也特别多。

en: I think it's kind of like a place where people go and walk their dogs
zh: 我觉得那里有点像是大家会带狗去散步的地方，

en: and we thought we could go there again today because all of the dogs are just so adorable
zh: 所以我们想着今天可以再去一次，因为那些狗狗都太可爱了，

en: and the grilled cheese sandwich was delicious.
zh: 而且那个烤芝士三明治也特别好吃。

en: I just need to figure out an outfit for today.
zh: 我现在只是得先想好今天穿什么。

en: It's obviously sunny. It's so beautiful when we wake up because you can see
zh: 今天天气显然很晴朗。我们每天醒来的时候都觉得特别美好，因为你能看到，

en: that there are like big, big windows here and there's no curtains for the big windows.
zh: 这里有那种很大很大的窗户，而且这些大窗户都没有窗帘。

en: So you just wake up with the sun in your eyes and it's just incredible.
zh: 所以你就是被阳光照着醒来，真的太美妙了。
